name: Riftglass Dragon - Young
description: Young Riftglass is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with fractured violet crystal plates reflecting unreal lives. It seeks to turn certainty into contradiction. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Crystal Claws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: False Reflection
abilities.description: The first attack against the dragon each GM turn has disadvantage.

abilities.name: Refraction Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 16. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the dragon moves the target to another visible place within Very Close range. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
